scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our picnic spot: convenience, scenery, activities, or cost?

options.name: Maple Grove City Park
options.upside: Easy access and plenty of shaded picnic tables
options.tradeoff: Can be crowded on weekends and limited playground options
options.concern: Noise from nearby traffic and other park visitors

options.name: Silver Lake Nature Reserve

options.tradeoff: Longer drive and fewer picnic tables available
options.concern: Limited shade and possible bugs near the water
options.best_for: enjoying nature and light outdoor activities

options.tradeoff: Higher reservation cost and less natural scenery
options.concern: Potential noise from sports events and less shade
options.best_for: families wanting active recreation alongside the picnic
